title: ChatCMDInput
description: Map the player's chat box input to commands
body:
### 🇬🇧 English Description  
✨ **ChatCMDInput** is a dynamic chat-based command input system that lets players trigger custom commands through natural chat messages—making gameplay more intuitive and interactive!

✅ Built **purely on the Bukkit API** — no Spigot/Paper-specific code  
🌍 Fully compatible with all major Bukkit-based servers: **Spigot, Paper, Purpur, Airplane**, and more (Minecraft 1.13+)  
📦 Lightweight · Stable · Zero NMS · Easy to deploy  
⚙️ Management command: `/ccmd reload | version | config | list`  
🔗 Optional dependency: PlaceholderAPI (for advanced placeholder support)

> ⚠️ Note: **Not compatible with Folia** (multi-threaded server architecture)

---

### 🇨🇳 中文描述  
✨ **ChatCMDInput** 是一个基于聊天输入的动态命令系统插件，允许玩家通过自然聊天方式触发自定义命令，大幅提升交互体验！

✅ **完全基于 Bukkit API 开发**，无任何服务端特有依赖（如 Spigot/Paper 专属 API）  
🌍 兼容所有主流 Bukkit 衍生服务端：**Spigot、Paper、Purpur、Airplane 等（Minecraft 1.13+）**  
📦 轻量 · 稳定 · 零 NMS 调用 · 易于部署  
⚙️ 支持子命令管理：`/ccmd reload | version | config | list`  
🔗 可选依赖：PlaceholderAPI（用于高级占位符支持）

> ⚠️ 注意：暂不支持 **Folia**（多线程架构服务端）
